title: Chapter close — Mass endomorphism
html:
This closes the mass-endomorphism chapter. We have assembled its structural backbone: the categorical mass identity, its existence and uniqueness, the Markov-trace endomorphism with its \phi_n global section, the \chi-character closed forms per Hecke irrep, and the Hecke-Baer-star chirality pairing. This machinery provides the inputs that the predicted-spectra and observations chapters consume to produce per-particle and per-isotope mass predictions.

The next chapter (mass theory) packages this machinery into the explicit six-term mass formula, the Hoefsmit / Wenzl-bridge / Markov-trace stack, and the \alpha_k coefficient table. This table drives every numerical mass prediction downstream.
